title: pteris serrulata
intro: Pteris serrulata, commonly known as the ladder fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory conditions, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pteris serrulata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
